extraction.Name: John B. DeCory
extraction.Refused/Protested: I never asked for the patent on my land, but took same, altho went broke. I was very doubtful if I could keep up the taxes on same, which I found I could not do, so finally had to sell same
extraction.Recorded patent: I asked a man by the name Wm. Schmidt who was working in the Rosebud Agency office at that time what I should do with the Patent, and in answer he said 'You might as well keep it as it has President Wilson's name signed to it' so I put Patent in my pocket and kept it.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Cash sale all in one payment which amount was $7000.00; Never Mortgaged.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I was very doubtful if I could keep up the taxes on same, which I found I could not do, so finally had to sell same
extraction.Occupation/Income: I support them with my salary that I receive as a Minister
extraction.NOTES: Patent was delivered by mail at Rosebud, S.D. in 1910; allottee never signed a receipt for it; never made application for the patent; $2000 of sale proceeds lost in the Mission State Bank of Mission, S.D.; wife and five children are dependents; document notarized June 1929.
